verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a GPU rental platform, for example removing or renting many pods in one command or call. The evidence only shows single-pod actions (`lium up`, `lium exec`, rent-by-spec) and bulk read-only feeds, such as every rentable node in one JSON call. Clusters are one distributed job, not batch actions over many items. None of this is a documented bulk-operation capability, so these adjacent features earn no credit.
